notes.title: Upcoming Release - Catch Love and Laughter with 'Sushi for Empress Setsuko'
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44530176/d99ed40556b66a0d5543034397f6f7ada34601d6.png[/img]

Hey there, Mew gamers! We're thrilled to announce the upcoming release of our latest game, "Sushi for Empress Setsuko." 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2593940/Sushi_for_Empress_Setsuko/?curator_clanid=44530176

Join Mizumi Nagashima in this cozy fishing adventure as she navigates life's storms. Her fishing boat took a hit, and she's on a mission to catch fish for Empress Setsuko to make ends meet.

This ain't your typical fishing game; it's a mix of yuri dating, point-and-click adventure, and fantastical Japan-inspired scenery that'll leave you in awe.

🌸 Explore breathtaking Medieval Japan-inspired landscapes.
😂 Get ready for an exciting and comedic storyline.
❤️ Meet multiple romanceable waifus on your journey.
🎶 Immerse yourself in a fusion of New Age and Japanese traditional music.

Will Mizumi make the Empress smile with her sushi? Can she fix her beloved fishing boat? Will she find love along the way?

Get ready for an unforgettable adventure filled with love, laughter, and delicious fish. "Sushi for Empress Setsuko" is coming soon, so stay tuned for the release date! 🍣🗾🌟

notes.title: Embark on a Journey of Love and Intrigue with 'The Queen's Quest
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44530176/fd7356d55ceabee3ecdef50da0e7d709b7fcbf20.png[/img]

Hey gamers! 🎮 Looking for something new and exciting to dive into? Check out "The Queen’s Quest" now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2559930/The_Queens_Quest/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

Get ready to embark on a wild journey with Elysia Fernwhisper. She's been through a lot – fought as Captain in the "War of the Crescent Lakes," got a plot of land for her bravery, but farming ain't her thing. She longs for her old adventurous life, especially now that her girlfriend's left her. With ongoing blues from hating her work, she's desperate for love. Then Valeria Dawnstriker knocks, offering a gig that'll flip their worlds!

"The Queen’s Quest" is a fantasy point-and-click adventure game mixed with a Yuri dating sim. Play as Elysia Fernwhisper, exploring a vast kingdom, uncovering mysteries, and maybe even finding love along the way.

But wait, there's more! Have you checked out the "Florida Love Stories Cookbook"? If you're into romantic comedy adventure games, you'll adore these Cuban-inspired recipes: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2583770/Florida_Love_Stories_Cookbook/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2517340/Florida_Love_Stories/

Get ready to play, discover, and devour new experiences. Don't miss out on these amazing games and the scrumptious cookbook. Grab 'em on Steam now! 🎉
